sources.title: OpenVPM 开源兽医诊所管理系统
quotes: Visual calendar with day/week views and column-per-doctor layout. Configurable appointment types with durations and colors.
SOAP notes with rich text editing. Problem lists (active/resolved/chronic). Vaccination records with reminders and certificate generation.
Prescription management with dosing calculator and refill tracking. Document and image attachments.
sources.limitations: AGPL-3.0 强传染性开源许可（网络服务部署需公开修改源码）；主面向北美小动物门诊，尚未原生支持中文医保/国内处方格式。
sources.why_selected: 目前 GitHub 上最现代、带 Vitest/Playwright E2E 测试与 REST API 的开源 PIMS，完整覆盖预约、SOAP 病历与剂量计算处方。

sources.title: OpenVPM 官网与托管产品规范
quotes: Prepare itemized estimates and invoices, review service and product charges, track payments and balances, and reconcile the day's billing.
Stock levels, reorder alerts, lot and batch tracking, expiration dates, and automatic deduction when items are dispensed from a medical record.
Client Communication A shared communication history for phone notes, configured email, portal requests, and approved two-way SMS pilots, all linked to the client record.
Scheduling, patient records, billing, and inventory in one place. Set it up yourself for free, or let us host it for you.
The versioned REST API supports selected client, patient, appointment, SOAP-note, and agent workflows, with scoped API keys, rate limiting, and signed webhook delivery.
sources.limitations: 官网明确标注急诊/专科/多院区尚处于 fit review 阶段而非生产就绪；AGPL-3.0 需注意网络服务分发边界。
sources.why_selected: OpenVPM 生产演示与托管官网独立域名，清晰定义分项估价转账单、批次效期扣减库存与客户门户请求流。

sources.title: PetCare (Laravel + Vue 宠物诊所患者管理系统)
quotes: Appointments: Schedule and manage appointments. The system allows you to view your calendar.
Patients: Manage all patient information, including medical history, treatment plans, and more.
Inventory: Keep track of all your clinic’s inventory. This includes medication, equipment, and any other items necessary for your practice.
sources.limitations: 单诊所轻量级 PMS，含 PHPUnit Feature 测试但缺少计费、影像与检验对接模块。
sources.why_selected: MIT 许可，自带物种/品种 Seeder 与 PHPUnit 测试，适合直接借鉴预约日历、病史/治疗计划与药品耗材库存模型。

sources.title: ARKA Veterinary Clinic 宠物诊所预约与门户系统
quotes: The client wanted a simple website with a contact form and a full booking management system, where he would be able to confirm or reject bookings and notify the client via email.
sources.limitations: 源自真实诊所外包项目重构，但聚焦门户展示、在线预约审批与邮件通知，不包含病历、处方与收费模块。
sources.why_selected: MIT 许可、166 星的 Next.js + Drizzle 真实诊所预约门户实现，补充宠主端预约确认与邮件触达交互。

sources.title: MixPet 宠物医院管理系统（网页端+医生端+微信小程序）
quotes:
二次完成时间：2023-3-09(完成医生的网页端，实现医生与客户在线聊天)
> * 最终完成时间：2023-3-28(完成用户端从网页到小程序的移植)
sources.limitations: 高校毕业设计项目，虽附完整 SQL 备份与微信小程序端，但未包含自动化测试与临床检验/影像标准协议。
sources.why_selected: MIT 许可且高星本土中文宠物医院实现，包含医生网页端在线问诊聊天与宠主微信小程序双端形态。

sources.title: VetVoice 兽医声动（宠物医院 AI 语音电子病历助手）
quotes: VetVoice 是一个面向宠物医院的 AI 语音病历助手，将 **诊疗对话实时转换为结构化电子病历**。
[2025.09.10]🎯📢 支持agent/mcp智能体，智能整理电子病历4个阶段：问诊阶段 / 开检查阶段 / 查看检查结果阶段 / 确诊治疗阶段。
开放http/mcp控制接口：当前病例号/开始录音/停止录音/辅诊/检查确诊/推荐用药/电子病历等
sources.limitations: 聚焦诊室语音采集与结构化病历生成插件，需配合已有 HIS 使用，本身不含收费、库存与住院笼位模块。
sources.why_selected: Apache-2.0 许可的中文宠物医院诊室插件，明确拆解门诊接诊四阶段（问诊→开检查→看结果→确诊推荐用药）。

sources.title: Spring PetClinic REST API
quotes: This project provides a RESTful API for managing a veterinary clinic's **owners, pets, veterinarians, visits, and specialties**.
sources.limitations: 教学与架构基准项目，重点在宠主/宠物/医生/就诊/专科基础领域模型与 OpenAPI 测试，不含住院、库存与财务。
sources.why_selected: Apache-2.0 行业经典样板后端，提供完整的 ER 模型、OpenAPI 3.1 契约与 Postman 集成测试。

sources.title: Spring PetClinic Angular 前端（Gitee 镜像）
quotes: Warning: **client only**. Use REST API from backend [spring-petclinic-rest project](https://github.com/spring-petclinic/spring-petclinic-rest)
Run `ng e2e` to execute the end-to-end tests via [Protractor](http://www.protractortest.org/).
sources.limitations: Gitee 仓库未显式声明许可证文件且为纯前端镜像，需配合 REST 后端运行；Angular 版本较旧。
sources.why_selected: Gitee 独立源上的宠物诊所前后端分离前端实现，含单元测试与端到端测试流程，提供除 GitHub 外的代码宿主交叉印证。

sources.title: Jakarta EE 10 PetClinic 需求与状态机文档
quotes: add an Owner, add her a Pet and book a visit for her Pet
Arquillian End2End Tests for REST Endpoints and for JSF Frontend Browser Tests with Graphene and Selenium.
sources.limitations: 演示性 Rosetta Stone 项目，EPL-2.0 弱传染许可需合规评审；未覆盖处方、收费与辅助检查。
sources.why_selected: 独立托管于 GitHub Pages，详细记录兽医专科（牙科/麻醉/外科/影像）、宠主宠物就诊预约状态机及端到端浏览器测试。

sources.title: Vetmanager REST API 认证与计费发现 PHP 包（Packagist）
quotes: vetmanager-token is library for work with token auth in Vetmanager API.
With vetmanager-url:^1.1 , configure Billing discovery separately:
sources.limitations: 仅为 Vetmanager 商业兽医 CRM 的认证与 Billing 端点发现客户端 SDK，不包含业务界面与完整数据模型。
sources.why_selected: MIT 许可且在 Packagist 累计 2,100+ 安装量、带 PHPUnit/PHPStan Dev 依赖，体现诊所 CRM 与 Billing 服务解耦的工程边界。

sources.title: vetclinic 开源兽医诊所 Web 系统（SourceForge）
quotes: Web based Veterinary Clinic Management software. Includes clients, pets, inventory (especially medicine), appointments, document management, invoicing, grooming, and boarding.
Pro Version will include options for Rx, invoicing, and inventory
Categories Calendar , Business Service Management , Healthcare , Clinic Management License GNU General Public License version 3.0 (GPLv3)
Programming Language JavaScript , PHP Database Environment MySQL
Evette Animal Clinic or Veterinary practice management. Stores and manipulates clients, animals, appointments, operations, medication, procedures.
sources.limitations: GPL-3.0 许可且项目停更较久（2017 年 Beta 状态），部分高级处方与账单功能标注在 Pro 版本中。
sources.why_selected: SourceForge 独立托管的 PHP/MySQL 诊所系统，支持 VeNom 诊疗术语、预约、药品库存与 Rx 处方模块划分。

sources.title: Activet 云端宠物医院管理平台
quotes: Activet brings scheduling, clinical records, billing, inventory, and the client portal into one calm, cloud platform — so your team can focus on care, not software.

Growth Most popular For a busy, multi-vet practice. Start 14-day free trial $89 / mo, billed yearly Everything in Starter 10 users included (+$15/extra user) CRM, boarding & referral portal Hospitalization, anesthesia & DICOM imaging
Each clinic runs in an isolated tenant with PostgreSQL row-level security. Your data stays yours — even across locations.
Append-only audit logs capture before/after diffs on every change, so compliance conversations stay short.
Ten configurable roles with granular CRUD and export permissions per entity. Give the right people the right access — nothing more.
sources.limitations: 专有商业 SaaS（All rights reserved），仅可参考产品分层、多租户 RLS 审计理念与子系统划分，禁止抄袭源码。
sources.why_selected: 生产级多租户云 PIMS，明确将住院（Hospitalization）、麻醉（anesthesia）与 DICOM 影像划入成长型医院核心子系统。

sources.title: Provet Cloud 兽医医院全流程平台特性
quotes: Insurance claims Send claims directly from the invoice and track statuses without re‑keying.
Imaging & PACS/DICOM Create worklists, view studies in‑record, and keep images tied to the medical history.
Integrated laboratories Order in a click and see results post back to the record with reference ranges and flags.
Treatment estimates → invoice Build transparent estimates, capture approvals, and carry accepted items straight to billing.
Inventory & wholesalers Automate reorders, manage expiries, and update prices from integrated wholesalers.
sources.limitations: 商业 SaaS 产品特性文档，专有许可；部分集成能力（如特定检验设备/保险直连）依赖欧美合作生态。
sources.why_selected: 服务全球 3,000+ 宠物医院的成熟生产级 PIMS，明确定义了账单直连保险理赔、DICOM 影像工作列表与检验结果回传病历流。

sources.title: Digitail AI 原生宠物医院管理系统
quotes: Provide continuous care for hospitalized and boarding pets through standardized feeding, monitoring, and hygiene workflows.
Keep every surgical and hospitalized patient moving through care safely. Track anesthesia, assign tasks, log procedures, and write discharge notes from one screen.
Order labs, see results, and prescribe medications in one place. Inventory updates automatically, so you always know what’s on hand and what needs to be reordered.
Dictate SOAP notes out loud while you examine, and finish your charts before you leave the room.
Pet owners can book appointments, view their pet’s records, and message the clinic from a pet parent mobile app.
sources.limitations: 商业 SaaS 平台，专有许可；页面描述以高层次工作流为主，不公开底层数据库表结构。
sources.why_selected: 生产级云 PIMS 标杆，按医院空间与动线拆解住院寄养监护、手术麻醉执行单与化验药房联动逻辑。

sources.title: Shepherd Veterinary Software 临床与计费联动特性
quotes: Shepherd's SOAP workflow mirrors how a visit unfolds. Vitals, notes, treatments, and discharge instructions live in one record, so there's nothing to piece together later.
Treatments land on the invoice when you confirm them Doses calculate and discharge instructions fill in as you go Follow-up tasks, like check-in calls, are created and assigned for you
Records, invoices, client messages, and payments stay connected from check-in to checkout.
Inventory Tracking Link inventory items to products and services, and counts update as you invoice
Build an estimate on the patient's page or inside a SOAP Add approved items to the treatment plan
sources.limitations: 商业专有 PIMS；面向美国兽医临床合规（如 Buoy's Law / Lizzie's Law 出院医嘱规范）。
sources.why_selected: 兽医主导设计的生产级 PIMS，体现 SOAP 病历、剂量自动计算与随访回访任务自动派发的临床闭环。

sources.title: ezyVet (IDEXX) 兽医医院平台特性
quotes: Imaging (Web PACS) View, annotate, and share radiographs and imaging directly within the patient record.
Order IDEXX tests and receive normalized results directly in the patient record.
Client Portal & App Give pet owners access to reminders, visit summaries, invoices, and messaging.
Treatment Sheets & Inpatient Tools Treatment plans, task tracking, and inpatient notes integrated into the medical record.
Automated Billing Charges from exams, treatments, and notes are added automatically as you work.
sources.limitations: 商业专有 PIMS（IDEXX 旗下），部分深度诊断与影像工作流与 IDEXX Web PACS / VetConnect PLUS 生态绑定。
sources.why_selected: 全球 7,000+ 医院使用的生产级大型医院 PIMS，清晰展示 Web PACS 影像批注、标准化化验结果回传与宠主门户闭环。

sources.title: Trupanion 宠物保险兽医端直付理赔门户
quotes: Our free, patented, web-based vet portal simplifies the process and allows us to provide claims decisions within minutes!
Electronic claims decisions and payment, often paid within seconds. We pay first! Trupanion can pay your hospital directly at checkout.
When pet parents are only responsible for their share of the bill, pets can visit the vet whenever they need to.
This free, web-based solution was created by veterinarians to help eliminate administrative hassles, so you can focus on providing the best care.
With Trupanion, pet parents can say yes to the care their pet needs, not just the care they can afford.
sources.limitations: 商业专有保险直付平台（All Rights Reserved），国内宠物医疗保险直付机制与保单条款存在本地差异。
sources.why_selected: 北美头部宠物保险直付（Vet Direct Pay）生产门户，揭示结账时实时理赔审批与分账支付对复诊粘性的影响。

sources.title: DataHub Vet 兽医 PIMS 统一集成 API
quotes: Install our lightweight agent at the clinic, connect via our REST API, and start syncing data in real time — patients, clients, appointments, invoices and more.
Access patient records, client information, appointments, invoices, inventory and more with sub-second latency through our veterinary API.
Connect your software to AVImark, Cornerstone, Impromed and other veterinary practice management systems through a single unified API with real-time data sync.
We help veterinary software companies access and sync clinic data through a single unified API, eliminating the need to build and maintain multiple PIMS integrations.
All data is encrypted in transit and at rest, with strict access controls and audit logging.
sources.limitations: 商业集成中间件官网，未公开 OpenAPI 细粒度 Schema 与开源许可信息。
sources.why_selected: 针对本地部署传统 PIMS（AVImark/Cornerstone/Impromed）的统一 REST 同步层，验证预约、账单与库存实体的行业最小交集。

sources.title: 2022 AAHA 犬类疫苗接种指南（2024 更新）
quotes: The guidelines include a comprehensive table listing canine core and noncore vaccines and a recommended vaccination and revaccination schedule for each vaccine.
sources.limitations: 临床权威规范指南（非软件实现），具体免疫程序与狂犬病法规需按所在国家/地区调整。
sources.why_selected: 升级原占位种子 VET-002 至 AAHA 权威疫苗指南正文页，直接支撑核心/非核心疫苗计划与再接种周期随访规则。

sources.title: 2020 AAHA 犬猫麻醉与监护指南
quotes: It’s a continuum of care that starts in the pet’s home and consists of four crucial phases: preanesthesia, induction, maintenance, and recovery.
sources.limitations: 临床安全指南（非软件源码），部分详细监护记录表格下载需 AAHA 会员权限。
sources.why_selected: 美国动物医院协会麻醉与手术监护权威标准，明确定义术前评估、诱导、维持与苏醒四阶段记录边界。

sources.title: WSAVA 世界小动物兽医协会全球疫苗接种指南
quotes: These Global Guidelines set out the latest scientific thinking on the vaccination of dogs and cats globally and give practical advice to veterinarians on optimum vaccination practice.
sources.limitations: WSAVA 版权保留（All Rights Reserved）临床指南，需配合犬猫疫苗表与亚洲地区推荐补充实施。
sources.why_selected: 提供与 AAHA 独立交叉验证的全球犬猫疫苗接种标准（含中文译本指引），支撑 M05 疫苗计划与 M06 免疫复诊随访。

sources.title: DICOM PS3.3 C.7 通用患者模块规范（含动物物种与品种属性）
quotes: Patient Species Description (0010,2201) 1C The taxonomic rank value (e.g., genus, subgenus, species or subspecies) of the Patient.
Note In the case of imaging a group of small animals simultaneously, the single Value of this identifier corresponds to the identification of the entire group.
sources.limitations: NEMA DICOM 国际医疗影像标准（非专有软件），聚焦影像患者元数据字段定义而非医院端 PACS 部署脚本。
sources.why_selected: 国际医学影像 DICOM 官方标准中关于非人动物患者（物种/品种/RFID芯片/责任人）的权威数据模型规范。
